stage computation: Three binary answer samples, each correct withp=.7 and independent; majority selects correct iff at least2 are correct. Enumerate8 joint outcomes and masses: success p³+3p²(1−p)=.784 versus one-sample.7. Odd sample count avoids ties.

**Countercase / boundary:** Perfectly correlated outcomes are all-correct withmass.7/all-wrong withmass.3; three-sample majority stays.7. Independentp=.4 gives majority.352, worse than.4. Independence is declared, not inferred from repeated text generation; samples may share errors.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether three votes must improve over one; recall p=.5 gives.5 and no gain under the independent symmetric binary rule.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Enumerate ballots exposes every joint state/probability and selected answer; Switch dependence then Lower accuracy computes distinct results while retaining independent.784 witness. Do not equate majority success with at-least-one success.
